title: Claude Code chat: allow more web searches for the video research
instructions: The project settings file is an enforcement-layer file, so I change it only on your words in the Claude Code chat, not from a console message. To allow it, type this line in the Claude Code chat: "Set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION to 400 in the project .claude/settings.json env." I make the change and commit it; then reload Claude Code so the new limit applies. Then press Done.
